title: About | MotmaenBash
description: About the MotmaenBash Android app and browser extension.
keywords: MotmaenBash, phishing protection, browser extension, Android app, online fraud, phishing
heading: About MotmaenBash
lead: MotmaenBash is a free, independent, open-source project that helps people recognize phishing and online fraud.
developerAfter: . The aim is a simple, practical tool, continued with help from users and volunteer developers.
developerParagraphs: Transparency and security come first, so the project code is published on GitHub.
You can help improve it. Suggestions and contributions on GitHub are welcome.
goals: Help people recognize online fraud, phishing, and ways to avoid them
Lower the risk of phishing and online fraud
Keep the project updated as new scams appear
features: A browser extension that checks online payment gateways
An Android app that checks SMS messages, links, and suspicious apps
A database that is updated as new scams appear
A way for people to report suspicious cases
donateText: A donation helps keep MotmaenBash updated.
